description: Change top-10 concentration max to 30%. Add holder history suspicion analysis (_analyze_holder_histories) to OnchainAnalyzer that checks top 5 holders for fresh wallets, same-block buying, common funder, and single-token wallets. Integrate into check_token output and unified_scanner rejection logic. Show holder_flags in Telegram alert.
steps: Update FiltersConfig.max_top10_concentration_pct default from 20.0 to 30.0 in config.py
Update CommonEvaluator max_top10_concentration_pct default from 20.0 to 30.0 in unified_scanner.py
Add _analyze_holder_histories method to OnchainAnalyzer in onchain.py
Integrate _analyze_holder_histories into check_token output as holder_suspicion dict
In CommonEvaluator.evaluate(), after coordinated_risk check, reject if holder_suspicion risk is HIGH
In format_signal(), add holder_flags to Telegram output if present
acceptance_criteria: _analyze_holder_histories checks top 5 holders via getSignaturesForAddress with limit=10
Detects fresh wallets (<5 total signatures), same-block buys (3+ in same slot), common funder, single-token wallets
check_token returns holder_suspicion dict with fresh_wallets, same_block_buys, common_funder, single_token_wallets, risk, details
CommonEvaluator rejects tokens with HIGH holder_suspicion risk
format_signal shows holder_flags in Telegram output
